messages:
anne: PR #13122 microbench failed on premerge gating, looks like batch-path latency jumped. perf-bot posted summary.
perf-bot: microbench 'batch_writer_throughput_v2' threshold 2.0% -> observed +17.8% median latency, tail +34% (CI job 4812345678).
raj: which commit touched batching? any obvious changes?
anne: the PR touches runtime/scheduler/coalescer.rs and runtime/kernel_selector.rs. main change: coalescer timer bump 3ms -> 6ms and adjusted kernel scoring weights. commit 9f3a2b4.
mike: repro'd locally with `./tools/perf/run_microbench --bench batch_writer_v2` — on my devbox median went 42ms -> 50ms. kv hit-rate dropped from 87% -> 61% in the run.
anne: kv hit-rate drop would explain token-path tail. do we have CI perf logs?
perf-bot: uploaded artifacts: /artifacts/4812345678/bench_output.txt (summary), /artifacts/4812345678/kv_stats.log.
raj: can you paste the small kv_stats snippet?
mike: pasted snippet: ```KV_CACHE_STATS: hits=3821 misses=2452 hit_rate=0.608```
raj: interesting. coalescer timer increase could increase batch sizes which should amortize cost, not reduce kv hit-rate. kernel selector weight change might cause more cold-path kernels chosen -> shorter KV reuse.
anne: trying a quick git bisect to confirm.
mike: ran `git bisect start HEAD v1.22.3 && git bisect bad && git bisect good v1.22.2` — bisect stopped at 9f3a2b4 (the PR commit).
raj: can you show diff that tweaks kernel weights? small snippet pls.
anne: snippet: ```- if seq_len < 64 { weight['fast_small'] += 3 } + if seq_len < 64 { weight['fast_small'] += 1; weight['safe_prefetch'] -= 2 }```
mike: also grabbed a short perf trace. flamegraph shows extra time in fast_small kernel for seq_len 32 requests; KV miss heatmap correlates with those samples.
sre-bot: NOTE: this thread flagged as potential rollout blocker for today's canary window.
raj: proposal: revert coalescer timer bump only and keep kernel weight tweak out of canary until we have more telemetry. revert candidate is commit 9f3a2b4~1.
anne: filed revert PR #13145 and added benchmark output to PR. linking artifacts in description.
mike: after reverting coalescer timer locally (keep new kernel weights) median improved a bit 50ms -> 45ms and hit-rate rose to 73% — not back to baseline, but better.
raj: OK land revert to unblock rollout, then iterate on kernel weights with smaller changes + canary with perf instrumentation. create follow-up issue to bisect kernel scoring in more depth.
perf-bot: CI re-run scheduled (job 4812345700).
perf-bot: rerun results: microbench median delta +2.1% (within threshold), kv hit_rate=84% — rollback looks good.
anne: reverting coalescer timer merged to main. follow-up issue: INF-2743 "kernel scoring regression investigation" created. :white_check_mark:
